management_steps.details: Eradication - Children 18 months-11 years: 250 mg 12 hourly for 10 days. Eradication - Children > 11 years and adults: 500 mg 12 hourly for 10 days. Prophylaxis: Children: 125 mg 12 hourly. Adults: 250 mg 12 hourly.
